status: frozen before source pixels were downloaded or inspected
purpose: Recover artificial integer offsets relative to a public surface-band convention; not establish recto, sheet identity, mesh accuracy, or ink improvement.
injection: For offset d, use original planes [4+d,24+d); correct displacement in the observed band is -d. No interpolation, padding, wraparound, or rescaling.
profile: Per-plane 10%-trimmed spatial mean over the 128x128 cell, computed on the original uint8 scale.
calibration: Only the twelve upper cells: median peak offset supplies one bias for the naive peak method; pointwise median of z-standardized 20-plane profiles supplies the conservative template. No thresholds are fit to the outcomes.
naive_method: Always return argmax(observed_profile)-9.5-calibration_peak_bias; ties choose the first maximum.

conservative_method.similarity: Pearson correlation of template[j] and observed_profile[j+correction] on the common twelve reference indices.
conservative_method.peak_guard: After [0.25,0.5,0.25] smoothing with edge replication, reject two local maxima separated by at least four planes if both have prominence at least 25% of the smoothed range. Peak prominence uses the higher of the two minima extending to a higher peak or band edge. This flags a possible second sheet; it does not identify a sheet.

primary_metrics: coverage on all 108 preselected validation cases
conditional fraction within one plane among accepted estimates
failure-to-abstain fraction among accepted estimates with error greater than one plane
unsafe accepted fraction among all 108 validation cases
per-offset and per-cell results, with cells as the clustering unit

minimum_go_criterion_for_further_public_.meaning: A diagnostic continuation gate only, never a deployment, ink-gain, or prize-validity claim. Additional independent surfaces and physical sheet checks remain necessary.

forbidden_inference: An original mesh plane is the ink-bearing surface.
A peak is the same anatomical sheet as the mesh.
Within-surface displacement recovery generalizes across scrolls.
Profile correlation or high CT intensity detects ink.
Repeated offsets of one patch are independent validation subjects.
resource_limit: Each CPU hypothesis must finish within roughly two CPU minutes; no model or GPU dependency.
publication: Only released PHerc0841 control coordinates and data. No unread-scroll candidate pixels or locations.
